steps.title: Audit existing WebView setup and lifecycle handlers
steps.description: Analyzed activity lifecycle and WebView background playback constraints to ensure playback continuity.

steps.title: Configure foreground service for media playback
steps.description: Set up BackgroundAudioService foreground notification and service types in compliance with Android SDK standards.

steps.title: Initialize Android MediaSession for background audio
steps.description: Integrated MediaSession compatibility for lock screen controls, system hardware key handling, and media notifications.

steps.title: Refine Audio Focus and interruption handling
steps.description: Ensured system audio focus transitions do not steal focus from internal WebView media engine.

steps.title: Implement JavaScript bridge for HTML5 Video state tracking
steps.description: Exposed real-time video playback events (play, pause, title update) from HTML5 element to native Java service.

steps.title: Inject HTML5 Page Visibility overrides
steps.description: Overrode document.hidden, visibilityState, and event listeners in WebView to prevent client-side auto-pausing when screen turns off.

steps.title: Prevent WebView destruction and unnecessary pauses on lock
steps.description: Maintained active WebView execution during onStop and onPause activity callbacks when phone is locked.

steps.title: Manage WakeLock for continuous background execution
steps.description: Acquired partial CPU wake lock safely during active audio sessions to keep web socket and playback threads active.

steps.title: Synchronize Media Notification controls with WebView state
steps.description: Linked foreground notification play/pause action buttons with HTML5 video element controls.

steps.title: Handle network and playback interruption events
steps.description: Added resilience for background streaming and transient network reconnects.

steps.title: Implement limitation notice for restricted YouTube playback
steps.description: Handled graceful notifications if web player enforces strict background restriction without extraction.

steps.title: Optimize memory and WebSettings for continuous audio
steps.description: Configured web settings, user agent, cookies, and DOM storage for seamless session retention.

steps.title: Validate Watch History and session persistence
steps.description: Verified background playback does not interfere with watch history recording and navigation controls.
